_설명: 탑20 롱폼 A편 「혼주 한복, 이것만 알면 됩니다」 장면 사양(2026-11-16). 가로 16:9 1920×1080. 소리는 narration-hanbok.json(토막 이름 「장 id-줄 번호」). video/scripts/top5/shorts-*.json 과 같은 생각: 장면 하나 = 토막 한두 개, kind 는 still(정지 그림에 느린 확대·이동)·clip(Veo 3.1 Fast 8초, 그림을 시작 프레임으로), p 는 object(사람·손 없음)·person(뒷모습만, 기준 그림을 참조로 올린다). 그림 파일은 장면 순서대로 img-01…, 움직이는 컷은 clip-NN. 장마다 제목 화면(title_seg 를 읽는 동안)과 한 줄 요약 화면(summary_seg 를 읽는 동안)이 붙는다 — 둘 다 그 장의 그림(bg)을 흐리게 깔고 글자만 얹어 새 그림을 그리지 않는다. cap 은 화면 글이 소리 글과 다른 줄만 적는다. 그림에 글자·숫자·옆얼굴·거울 속 얼굴·손을 그리지 않는다.
title: 혼주 한복, 이것만 알면 됩니다 — 저고리 색부터 속옷·귀걸이까지
hook:
혼주 한복 저고리
왜 다 똑같은 아이보리일까요?

cap.c4-01: 평소 악세서리를 하지 않던 혼주님도, 결혼식 당일에 몇 가지만 착용하면 2배 더 예뻐 보입니다.

scenes.img: Inside a bright modern hanbok boutique, a long wooden rail with a row of seven nearly identical ivory-white silk jeogori (short Korean hanbok jackets) on wooden hangers, their long goreum ribbons hanging down, all the same pale ivory color, soft daylight from a side window.
scenes.m: The long ribbons of the jackets sway very slightly as if in a faint breeze. Static camera, no people, no hands.

scenes.img: Two silk jeogori laid side by side on a cream cloth: one pale ivory, one soft coral pink. Beside them two folded chima skirts, one warm yellow and one deep blue, the fabric folds catching the light.

A half-open hanbok gift box lined with thin white tissue paper on a pale wooden floor, a folded silk hanbok just visible inside, a pink bojagi wrapping cloth loosely untied around the box, calm morning light.
A small lacquer tray on cream silk holding a Korean dwikkoji hair ornament with a jade flower, a pair of white pearl earrings and a single pearl ring, arranged with space between them.

Wide back view of the woman seated on a stool in a bright makeup studio, facing a makeup counter with brushes and palettes; the mirror above the counter is draped with a pale cloth so nothing is reflected. Soft daylight from the left.
scenes.m: Soft daylight shifts gently across her shoulders and hair; she stays still and never turns.

scenes.img: A single ivory silk jeogori on a wooden hanger in front of a large boutique window; outside the window, red and orange autumn maple leaves. Warm autumn afternoon light.
An ivory silk jeogori in the center on a cream cloth, with a folded rose-red chima skirt on its left and a folded deep blue chima skirt on its right, symmetrical composition.
A hanbok shop counter of pale wood with a neat stack of folded ivory silk jeogori, shelves of rolled silk fabric softly visible behind, no people.
Three exactly identical ivory silk jeogori hanging side by side at equal spacing on a wooden rail against a plain cream wall, like matching uniforms, their goreum ribbons hanging straight.
scenes.m: The three ribbons sway very slightly, one after another. Static camera, no people, no hands.

scenes.img: Two silk fabric swatches side by side on a plain table: one pale ivory, one dull muted yellowish beige. Flat overcast light, quiet and slightly dull mood.
A folded ivory silk jeogori on a grey stone table under flat cool light, the ivory looking pale and flat, a small empty ceramic dish beside it.

A makeup artist's table with foundation bottles, a blush and eyeshadow palette in warm rosy tones and a jar of brushes; behind the table an ivory silk jeogori hangs on a wooden hanger. No mirror in view. Warm bright light.
scenes.m: Warm light flickers softly across the brushes and the palette; the jacket ribbon moves very slightly. Static camera, no people, no hands.

scenes.img: Five folded silk jeogori in a neat row on a cream cloth, each a different soft color: peach pink, mint green, lavender, sky blue and pale apricot.
On a hanbok shop counter, an open flat gift box presenting a neatly folded ivory silk jeogori on tissue paper; rolls of colorful silk stand unnoticed on a shelf in the background.
Back view of the woman standing by a tall bright window in a wedding hall lounge, her pale pink jeogori glowing softly in the light, waist-up framing, flowers on a side table.
scenes.m: Sunlight shimmers softly on the pink silk and the curtain moves a little; she stands still and never turns.

scenes.img: A wooden clothes rail with silk jeogori in many gentle colors — coral, mint, lavender, soft yellow, sky blue — hanging in sunlight, cheerful and airy.

scenes.img: A single plain white silk jeogori with no decoration, laid flat on a cream cloth, lots of empty space around it, quiet and a little plain.
Two folded silk chima skirts side by side on a wooden table: one in rose red tones, one in deep blue tones, traditional and dignified.
Close-up of a white silk jeogori sleeve and collar with delicate floral embroidery in pale silver and soft pink thread and a small decorative trim.

A white silk jeogori and a bright warm yellow full chima skirt displayed together on a tall wooden hanbok rack beside a sunny wedding hall window, the yellow skirt falling in long pleats to the floor.
scenes.m: The yellow skirt pleats sway very gently and sunlight ripples over the silk. Static camera, no people, no hands.

scenes.img: Close-up of bright yellow silk chima pleats filling most of the frame, with a folded deep blue chima set aside at the right edge.
A bright, elegant modern wedding hall lobby with tall flower arrangements in white and yellow, warm chandelier light, polished floor, festive and welcoming, no people.
scenes.m: Flower petals stir slightly and the warm light glimmers softly. Static camera, no people, no hands.

scenes.img: A hanbok bundle wrapped in a soft pink bojagi cloth with a neat knot, resting on a low wooden table in a quiet bedroom corner, morning light through a paper window.
A pale pink jeogori and a wide deep magenta chima laid flat together on a cream cloth, showing the loose, generous, flowing A-line shape of the hanbok.
Close-up of the lower hem of a pale pink jeogori lying smooth and flat over the high white waistband of a magenta chima, the goreum ribbon tied in a neat bow.
A pale pink silk jeogori on a wooden hanger against a cream wall, its long goreum ribbon hanging down, soft window light from the side.
scenes.m: The long ribbon sways very slightly and the light shifts softly. Static camera, no people, no hands.

scenes.img: A windowsill with two small ceramic vases: the left holds a branch of pink spring blossoms in warm light, the right holds a bare winter branch with a dusting of snow in cool light.
A sheer thin white silk jeogori sleeve laid over two fabric swatches on a table: a skin-toned beige swatch that almost disappears under the silk, and a dark navy swatch that clearly shows through it.
A pair of embroidered Korean flower shoes (kkotsin) placed neatly on a pale wooden floor beside the hem of a magenta silk chima.
A complete hanbok set — pale pink jeogori and long deep magenta chima — displayed on a tall wooden hanbok rack in a bright quiet room, the skirt hem reaching the floor, dignified and formal.
scenes.m: The skirt hem and the ribbon move very slightly; soft light drifts across the silk. Static camera, no people, no hands.

scenes.img: An open wooden jewelry box lined with cream silk on a dressing table, holding a dwikkoji hair ornament, a pair of white pearl earrings and a ring, soft warm light.
scenes.m: Tiny glints of light move slowly over the pearls and the ornament. Static camera, no people, no hands.

scenes.img: Close-up of a single Korean dwikkoji hair ornament — a short pin topped with a jade flower and small pearls — lying on pale pink silk.
Close back view of the woman's neat low chignon with a jade-and-pearl dwikkoji ornament pinned into it, the collar of her pale pink jeogori below, a softly blurred wedding hall behind.
scenes.m: Light glints softly on the hair ornament and a few fine hairs stir; she stays still and never turns.

scenes.img: A pair of white pearl earrings in sharp focus on cream velvet in the foreground; behind them, softly blurred, earrings with red, blue and green gemstones.
Close-up of a pair of earrings, each a round white pearl ringed by a halo of tiny sparkling clear cubic stones, on cream silk.
A green jade ring and a white pearl ring resting side by side on folded pastel hanbok silk.
A pair of white formal gloves folded and set aside at the edge of a dressing table, with a small ceramic ring dish holding a jade ring in the foreground.

scenes.img: Full-length back view of the woman standing in a bright wedding hall corridor in the pale pink jeogori and deep magenta chima, the graceful curved lines of the sleeves and the full skirt clearly visible.
scenes.m: The skirt hem sways very slightly and light moves softly on the silk; she stands still and never turns.

scenes.img: Two pairs of pearl earrings side by side on a cream cloth: on the left a pair of dark black pearls, on the right a pair of bright white pearls that glow softly.
A small round table mirror seen from behind — only its wooden back and stand are visible — and in front of it on the table one white pearl earring and one black pearl earring lying apart.
A pair of slim elongated teardrop pearl earrings laid vertically on cream silk, next to a round white moon jar, the long shape contrasting with the round jar.
A pair of round button-shaped pearl earrings on cream silk, next to a tall slender celadon vase, the round shape contrasting with the long vase.
Close-up of a pair of simple white pearl stud earrings sitting on a small cream earring card stand, neat and close-fitting, soft light.
A pair of long dangling drop earrings with small pearls hanging from a slender brass jewelry stand on a dressing table, plain cream background.
scenes.m: The dangling earrings swing gently back and forth. Static camera, no people, no hands.
